title: Multi-head Quantum Neural Networks: Replacing Transformer Blocks with NISQ Modules inside a 30-Billion-Parameter LLM
abstract: arXiv:2611.15250v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce the multi-head quantum neural network (QNN), a quantum module compatible with noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) devices that can replace transformer blocks inside pre-trained large language models (LLMs) with little loss in accuracy and with far fewer parameters than the blocks it replaces. Encoding a model's $D$ hidden neurons into a qubit register is the obstacle: amplitude encoding scales poorly in circuit depth and angle encoding in qubit count, so neither is practical at production-scale width. We instead partition the hidden space into $k$ disjoint heads, angle-encode each into an $n_q$-qubit register, process the heads in parallel, and couple them through constrained classical linear layers, the mixers. Performing surgery on Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507, we show that a single multi-head QNN with $145\,281$ trainable parameters ($D=2048$, $k=32$, $n_q=8$, $L=4$) can replace a contiguous span of eight transformer

translated_title: 多头量子神经网络：在300亿参数大语言模型中用NISQ模块替换Transformer块
translated_abstract: 我们提出了多头量子神经网络（QNN），这是一种与含噪声中等规模量子设备兼容的量子模块，能够以极小的精度损失替换预训练大语言模型（LLM）中的Transformer块，且参数量远少于被替换的模块。将模型的D个隐藏神经元编码到量子比特寄存器中是主要障碍：振幅编码在电路深度上扩展性差，角度编码在量子比特数量上扩展性差，因此两者在生产规模的宽度下都不实用。我们转而将隐藏空间划分为k个不相交的头，将每个头角度编码到n_q个量子比特的寄存器中，并行处理各个头，并通过受限的经典线性层（即混合器）将它们耦合起来。通过对Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507模型进行“手术”改造，我们证明了单个拥有145,281个可训练参数（D=2048，k=32，n_q=8，L=4）的多头QNN可以替换连续八个Transformer块的跨度。（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种兼容NISQ设备的多头量子神经网络模块，通过将隐藏空间分头角度编码并并行处理，仅用约14.5万可训练参数即可替换Qwen3-30B大语言模型中的八个连续Transformer块，且精度损失极小。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces a NISQ-compatible multi-head quantum neural network module that partitions the hidden space into parallel angle-encoded heads, and demonstrates that a single module with only ~145K trainable parameters can replace eight contiguous transformer blocks inside the 30-billion-parameter Qwen3 LLM with little accuracy loss.
